visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two people, a female with long brown hair in a white robe and a male with dark hair in a white shirt, sit before a grey plastic sheet backdrop with studio equipment visible. They smile, gesture towards a beige quilted makeup bag, and look directly at the camera. (2) The female character opens the bag and pulls out a package of dental floss; she holds it up while the male character points at it. (3) The female character reveals a purple foil skincare packet, holding it close to the lens to show the details while her facial expression remains bright and animated. (4) She holds up a sleek black Y-shaped electronic beauty device; she demonstrates it by rolling it along her jawline while the male character watches with an open-mouthed, laughing expression. (5) Three small glass dropper bottles are displayed in the center of the frame; the female character holds two and the male character holds one, showcasing the different colored liquids inside. (6) A tall pinkish-silver spray bottle is presented; the female character sprays it into the air above her face with her eyes closed, while the male character leans in curiously. (7) A clear plastic rectangular palette containing several shades of cream concealer is shown in a close-up, followed by the female holding a thin makeup brush alongside it. (8) A dual-ended pink and gold lipstick tube is held up by the female; she then applies it to her lips while looking at the camera. (9) Two square blush compacts, one gold and one silver, are held up together; the female uses a small brush to apply the product to her cheek. (10) A large, ergonomic black seat cushion with neon green trim is pulled out from below the frame; the male character holds it and eventually sits on it, showing a comfortable posture. (11) Both characters wave to the camera and point toward the makeup bag again as the scene ends with an overlay title.
